INSERT INTO learner_memory_claim_revision ( claim_key, user_id, entry_kind, dimension, tag_id, revision_no, status, claim_text, claim_text_hash, origin_type, evidence_pattern, evidence_grade, decision_reason, update_run_id, supersedes_revision_id, valid_from, valid_to) VALUES ( #{draft.claimKey}, #{draft.userId}, #{draft.scope.kind}, #{draft.scope.dimension}, #{draft.scope.tagId}, #{draft.revisionNo}, #{draft.status}, #{draft.claimText}, #{draft.claimTextHash.value}, #{draft.origin}, #{draft.evidencePattern}, #{draft.evidenceGrade}, #{draft.decisionReason}, #{draft.updateRunId}, #{draft.supersedesRevisionId}, #{draft.validFrom}, #{draft.validTo}) RETURNING

mapper.select: SELECT evidence.claim_revision_id, evidence.review_id, evidence.evidence_role, evidence.sequence_no, evidence.created_at FROM learner_memory_claim_review_evidence evidence JOIN learner_memory_claim_revision claim ON claim.id = evidence.claim_revision_id JOIN practice_code_review review ON review.id = evidence.review_id WHERE claim.user_id = #{userId} AND evidence.claim_revision_id IN #{revisionId} ORDER BY evidence.claim_revision_id, review.created_at ASC, evidence.review_id ASC

SELECT evidence.claim_revision_id, evidence.message_id, evidence.evidence_role, evidence.sequence_no, evidence.created_at FROM learner_memory_claim_message_evidence evidence JOIN learner_memory_claim_revision claim ON claim.id = evidence.claim_revision_id JOIN agent_message message ON message.id = evidence.message_id WHERE claim.user_id = #{userId} AND evidence.claim_revision_id IN #{revisionId} ORDER BY evidence.claim_revision_id, message.created_at ASC, evidence.message_id ASC
SELECT id FROM practice_code_review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id IN #{reviewId} ORDER BY id
SELECT message.id FROM agent_message message JOIN agent_task task ON task.id = message.task_id WHERE task.user_id = #{userId} AND message.id IN #{messageId} ORDER BY message.id
